deadline.value: The College of Engineering table gives February 1 for international Fall applicants and July 1 for domestic and Mexican applicants; the program admits only in Fall.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: The fetched pages do not say a supervisor must agree before admission.

funding.value: The fetched pages do not describe PhD funding.

entry_route.value: A BS or MS degree in a related field, preferably engineering, is required.
entry_route.quote: requires a BS or MS degree in a related field preferably in engineering

gre_general.value: The College of Engineering lists the GRE as optional; the department says it considers GRE scores for all applicants.

also.quote: GRE Scores will also be considered for all applicants

toefl_min.value: The department gives only the old 550 paper-based, 213 computer-based and 80 internet-based scores, which are not recorded; the Graduate School's 4.5 (new scale) applies.
toefl_min.quote: 550 on the paper based test, 213 on the computer based test, and 80 on the internet based test
